jobgether-jobgether:lever:0ec2ec20-ed25-.title: Executive Director, Analytics Engineering
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0ec2ec20-ed25-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Executive Director, Analytics Engineering based in United States. This senior leadership role will shape the foundation for analytics at enterprise scale, enabling teams to make smarter, more data-driven decisions. You will establish the systems, standards, frameworks, and capabilities required to make analytics consistent, trusted, and repeatable. The role spans multiple business domains, connecting analytics efforts across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, and other functions. You will champion analytical rigor, governance, quality assurance, and scalable analytics engineering practices. Success will require a balance of visionary thinking and pragmatic execution, turning ambiguous challenges into durable enterprise capabilities. You’ll work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to influence strategy and create solutions that can be reused across diverse business needs. This fully remote U.S. opportunity offers significant scope to institutionalize analytics as a strategic organizational capability. Establish and champion enterprise-wide analytics rigor, including statistical standards, validation protocols, quality assurance practices, and consistent methodologies. Define frameworks for measurement, performance metrics, reporting, and analytical standards that enable reliable decision-making across the organization. Build and institutionalize analytics engineering as a core discipline, including reusable data pipelines, analytics automation, and production-grade analytical solutions. Develop scalable capabilities and frameworks that allow analytical solutions to be transferred efficiently across use cases and business areas. Connect analytics initiatives across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, and other functions to improve collaboration, consistency, and organizational impact. Architect systems and operating models that make analytics a repeatable, trusted, and efficient enterprise capability. Support data and analytics governance, ensuring outputs meet applicable regulatory, ethical, quality, and compliance expectations. Partner closely with business leaders and functional stakeholders to bring data-driven insights and challenge assumptions where appropriate. Translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Balance strategic design with operational execution, ensuring frameworks and capabilities translate into practical business outcomes. Establish structures that improve the full analytics lifecycle, from data ingestion and engineering through analysis and ultimately to business decision-making. Influence enterprise priorities by bringing a systems-level perspective on how analytics capabilities can drive better decisions and scalable impact. Requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of experience in data and analytics, with demonstrated success building scalable systems, frameworks, platforms, or capabilities. Proven experience establishing analytics standards, governance frameworks, measurement methodologies, or platform capabilities. Strong experience working cross-functionally across complex organizations, ideally within Commercial, Medical, Market Access, life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated environment. Experience with analytics engineering, business intelligence tools, data infrastructure, and scalable analytical solutions. Strong understanding of the end-to-end data lifecycle, from data ingestion and engineering through analysis and decision-making impact. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences. Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how analytics capabilities connect across an enterprise

southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:5f.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. About the Role As an Event Marketer at Cognition, you will design and deliver the in person experiences that bring our brand and go-to-market strategy to life, from executive programs to large-scale conferences and sponsorship activations. Your events will drive brand awareness, pipeline creation, deal acceleration, and deeper relationships with our most important accounts. You will own Cognition's event experience end to end, from concept and design through onsite execution, ensuring every program reflects our brand at the highest level of quality and leaves a lasting impression on attendees. This role is execution-heavy. We are looking for someone who obsesses over details, runs flawless events end to end, thrives under pressure, and coordinates cross-functional teams with precision. In this role, you will: - Manage Cognition's presence at priority industry conferences and sponsorship activations, including booth design, experiential elements, and attendee engagement strategy - Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to develop compelling event collateral, messaging, and follow-up assets - Own the full logistical lifecycle of events, from vendor negotiations and budget management to contracts, staffing, and scheduling - Craft communications before and after each event, including "Know Before You Go" guides, training for staff and speakers, and structured follow-up outreach - Partner with Field Marketing to engage the GTM team and monitor key event metrics, such as leads generated, pipeline contribution, meetings booked, and audience engagement, to gauge success and shape future planning - Create repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and reference materials that scale alongside Cognition's expanding events calendar - Serve as the primary point of contact for outside agencies, suppliers, and venue teams - Be present at events in person to manage logistics directly and keep execution running smoothly - Use feedback from stakeholders and post-event reviews to continually refine and improve the events function Requirements for the role: - 3-5 years of experience in event marketing at a company known for high-impact events and executive programs or at a premium experiential agency with demanding production standards and large budgets - Proven ability to run end-to-end events including planning, logistics, vendor management, run-of-show creation, and onsite execution under pressure - Experience managing events ranging from 10 to 1,000+ attendees - Track record supporting senior audiences (C-level, VP Eng, CTO) and partnering closely with sales and GTM teams to drive business outcomes - Strong organizational rigor, attention to detail, and a high personal quality bar - Proficiency with tools such as Salesforce and HubSpot - Ability to travel up to 40% You might excel if you… - Have led event marketing programs at a high-growth startup - Enjoy designing executive experiences and creating moments that differentiate a brand - Thrive when traveling, hosting, problem-solving, and adapting in real time - Are highly organized and operationally minded while still creative - Are energized by high-intensity environments where expectations are high and outcomes are measurable - Think like an owner of the event experience and business impact, not just an executor of logistics EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. triedgeinvestments-triedge-investments:a.description: People Associate About TriEdge Investments TriEdge Investments is a family office and technology company based in New York. We make concentrated investments in a few companies. We also incubate technology companies to solve the problems our investment team observes in our portfolio companies. In this sense, we've proven it's a true industry problem. We only focus on select healthcare verticals. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes and reduce the complexity of healthcare through better investing and technology. To do this, we find and foster extraordinary people who can think hyper-rationally yet with creativity. Our talent philosophy is that to do something different, you must be different. We enjoy working with people who think so too. What We're Really Looking For We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented People Associate to help deliver an exceptional employee experience across the full employee lifecycle. In this role, you will partner closely with employees, leaders, and external partners to support People Operations, employee programs, talent initiatives, and organizational growth. You’ll play a key role in ensuring a seamless employee experience, maintaining operational excellence across people processes, supporting managers and employees, and helping scale People practices as the organization grows. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys both strategic and operational work and wants to contribute meaningfully within a high-performance, fast-growing environment. Key Responsibilities - Drive people initiatives across onboarding, performance management, compensation, employee development, engagement, and other employee lifecycle programs - Partner with leadership on people reporting and analytics, supporting workforce planning, headcount reporting, turnover analysis, and other people insights - Facilitate employee equity administration, coordinating with legal counsel, employees, and internal stakeholders - Partner with external immigration counsel, employees, and hiring managers to facilitate visa and immigration processes - Develop and maintain HR resources, presentations, communications, training materials, and employee-facing documentation - Identify opportunities to improve employee experience, strengthen people operations, and build scalable processes that support organizational growth - Manage employee offboarding processes, including payroll coordination, documentation, systems access, and asset return logistics - Partner with employees and leaders throughout the employee lifecycle, helping deliver a consistent, high-quality employee experience, and serve as a trusted resource for employee questions and people-related matters, providing guidance and escalating issues when appropriate - Prepare and facilitate offer letter generation, background checks, and pre-employment documentation for new hires - Lead onboarding processes, including coordination of welcome communications, technology setup, benefits enrollment, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement to ensure a smooth transition into the organization - Partner with our PEO and internal stakeholders on employee record management, benefits administration, payroll processes, compliance matters, and policy execution - Contribute to strategic People initiatives, departmental goals, and other projects as needed Who You Are - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field - 4+ years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, People Business Partnering, or related roles - High integrity with the ability to handle sensitive employee information with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment - Strong skills in the Microsoft Office Suite - Tech-savvy and able to learn new tools quickly; experience with PEO platforms, HRIS, payroll systems, and productivity tools (e.g., Slack, Asana, etc.) is preferred - Experience supporting compensation administration, employee lifecycle processes
